nodes.label: Historical Windows read-only sync defect
nodes.rationale: Read-only File::open handle caused sync_data Access denied before storage cutover.

nodes.label: JSONL retained for legacy compatibility
nodes.rationale: Live StorageManager reads and writes use SQLite; legacy utilities are not a second authority.

nodes.label: Atomic digest-tracked legacy JSONL import
nodes.rationale: Byte-verified backups protect originals; changed or ambiguous imports require review.

nodes.label: Approved migration 1
nodes.rationale: Only schema_migrations, workspaces, sessions, events and legacy_imports were approved.

nodes.label: Unapproved pipeline schema and IPC proposal
nodes.norm_label: unapproved pipeline schema and ipc proposal
nodes.rationale: Original runs/stages/attempts/tool tables and run_pipeline contract were superseded by minimal storage approval.

nodes.label: OS-backed single-runtime storage lock
nodes.rationale: Retain exclusive runtime.lock ownership until the final storage clone drops.

nodes.label: SQLite sessions.db authoritative history
nodes.rationale: Replace split JSONL/index durability boundaries with atomic transactions.

nodes.label: Verified SQLite backup and restore
nodes.rationale: VACUUM INTO snapshot is checked for integrity, foreign keys and schema; existing destinations are refused.

nodes.label: Step 1: verified historical baseline
nodes.rationale: Earlier green results precede incomplete step 4 and do not verify current code.

nodes.label: Interruptible inference scaffolding
nodes.rationale: StreamCancellation and turn ownership guards exist but are not connected to execution.

nodes.label: Unpopulated ProviderConfig test fields
nodes.rationale: Two test initializers omit new fields; handoff identifies this by source inspection without fresh compilation.

nodes.label: Step 3: single-model execution and approvals
nodes.rationale: Real session IDs connect pending approvals to their registered session.

nodes.label: Historical 91 Rust passes and 7 frontend passes
nodes.norm_label: historical 91 rust passes and 7 frontend passes
nodes.rationale: Historical results are not verification of incomplete step 4.

nodes.label: Step 5 sequential pipeline remains future work
nodes.norm_label: step 5 sequential pipeline remains future work
nodes.rationale: Ordered stages, durable transitions and stop on failure are outside steps 1–4.

nodes.label: Explicit Ollama Qwen JSON compatibility
nodes.rationale: Qwen returned complete tool JSON in ordinary content instead of native tool-call frames.

nodes.label: Step 4: incomplete execution reliability
nodes.rationale: Cancellation, provider protocol validation and context checks remain unwired.

nodes.label: Step 2: SQLite workspace sessions and history
nodes.norm_label: step 2: sqlite workspace sessions and history
nodes.rationale: SQLite is authority; local storage remembers selections only.

nodes.label: Unagreed sidebar rename/archive/delete semantics
nodes.rationale: Actions remain disabled until persistence/deletion semantics are agreed.

nodes.label: Tool schema validation and failed shell exits
nodes.norm_label: tool schema validation and failed shell exits

nodes.label: Historical backend baseline and approved minimal storage
nodes.norm_label: historical backend baseline and approved minimal storage

nodes.label: WAL FULL transactions and visible save failures
nodes.norm_label: wal full transactions and visible save failures
nodes.rationale: A completed generation is not durable until its event transaction commits.

nodes.label: Immutable events and same-session earlier parents
nodes.norm_label: immutable events and same-session earlier parents
nodes.rationale: Insert, update and delete triggers protect append-only history and parent ordering.

nodes.label: Backend-only publication boundary
nodes.rationale: Frontend and Rust interface changes depend on each other; publishing only backend does not deliver the full UI fix.

nodes.label: Stop with clear context-budget error
nodes.rationale: User chose preserving complete history over dropping older turns; proposed byte budget remains unenforced.

nodes.label: Approval test retry and loop deadlines
nodes.norm_label: approval test retry and loop deadlines
nodes.rationale: Wait for delivered approval rather than relying on fixed sleeps; deadline cannot forcibly terminate a Rust thread.

nodes.label: Required approval session identity
nodes.rationale: A default session fallback lost decisions registered under a real session.

nodes.norm_label: approval for scope and contract expansion

nodes.label: Git operations require authorization
nodes.rationale: No automatic commits, pushes, branches or destructive resets.

nodes.label: Minimal targeted changes
nodes.rationale: Preserve working code and user modifications.

nodes.label: Explicit task scope
nodes.rationale: Avoid changing unrelated behavior or files.

nodes.label: No intentional secret access
nodes.rationale: Do not expose credentials, tokens or secret environment variables.

nodes.label: Relevant verification
nodes.rationale: Test requested changes without fixing unrelated failures.
